Application Data.NAME: Vineyard Beverage Distributors, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Vineyard Beverage Distributors, Inc. specializes in the wholesale and retail distribution of a diverse range of alcoholic beverages, including high-quality wines, craft beers, and premium spirits. Our operations consist of sourcing products from licensed suppliers, maintaining a well-trained staff that adheres to responsible beverage service training, and implementing robust age verification procedures to ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations. We operate a secure facility equipped with central alarm systems and video surveillance to protect our high-value inventory. Additionally, we have recently expanded our services to include online sales while ensuring all shipping practices comply with legal requirements, including age verification at delivery.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2022, a delivery vehicle backed into a storage rack, causing damage to inventory valued at $10,000. The claim was submitted, and the status is currently settled with payment received. Additionally, on 08/12/2021, a theft incident occurred where products worth $5,000 were stolen from the warehouse. This claim was also settled successfully.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Sunday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Electronic Safe, 1500 lbs capacity, with biometric access and monitored alarm system.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures implemented, including a secure perimeter fence, 24-hour video surveillance system, and a dedicated watchperson during after-hours operations to protect inventory and ensure compliance with safety protocols.
